title: Introducing Read Alouds
transcript:
Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6 and Z podcast. I'm Sonal. I wanted to let you know about a special new series of read outlaws that were starting, and for which I've shared more about the why and the why now on previous episodes, including episode number 500, on how we podcast. But first up in the next episode that you'll hear in this feed is our first ever read aloud of an essay by an A6 and Z author. And the piece is, it's time to build by Mark Andreson.
